en: The image is a black-and-white photograph depicting a man in a suit standing beside a display table filled with nuts and other produce. The table is well-arranged with baskets and boxes containing walnuts and other nut varieties. There are jars on the right side of the table, possibly containing preserved goods. Behind the table, there is a sign in Cyrillic script and several smaller photographs pinned on a board, likely showing scenes related to the business or location. The overall setting looks like an exhibition or market fair.
